sources.supports: DTC is reduced-stability traction setting; cluster TRACTION text plus illuminated indicator. Does not identify OFF glyph in text.
DSC OFF caption+indicator when deactivated; flashing DSC lamp means regulating drive/brakes; steady DSC lamp can mean failure/initialization.
